LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_WetCloth.label: stale wet cloth
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_WetCloth.description: An old cloth soaked in water and tied at the waist. It takes the edge off the heat until it dries.
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudCoat.label: dry mud coating
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudCoat.description: A thick coat of dried mud. It cracks and sheds, but it keeps the sun off.
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_ReedWrap.label: reed shade wrap
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_ReedWrap.description: A loose wrap of dry reeds. It blocks the sun and lets heat out.
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_BarkWrap.label: soaked bark wrap
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_BarkWrap.description: Wet strips of bark tied on. It smells bad and stays cool for a while.
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudMantle.label: mud and reed mantle
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudMantle.description: A thick pad of mud and reeds. Wet and heavy, and useful under a hard sun.
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudShell.label: heavy cooling mud
LanguageData.RHAH_Heat_MudShell.description: Several layers of dried mud. It cracks when the wearer moves and holds off severe heat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_ThinHemp.label: thin hemp layer
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_ThinHemp.description: A small piece of rough hemp. It stops little wind, and it is better than nothing.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_LayeredHemp.label: layered hemp
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_LayeredHemp.description: Several layers of rough hemp. Ugly, and warm enough to matter.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_StrawQuilt.label: straw and bark quilt
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_StrawQuilt.description: Dry straw and bark sewn into old cloth. It rustles and keeps some cold out.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_FurCloak.label: patched fur cloak
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_FurCloak.description: A short cloak of fur scraps. The seams are open, and the wind does not cut straight through.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_SmokedBlanket.label: smoke-stiffened blanket
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_SmokedBlanket.description: An old blanket stiffened by smoke and grease. Dirty, hard, and enough to keep the cold off.
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_HideWrap.label: thick hide wrap
LanguageData.RHAH_Cold_HideWrap.description: Layers of hide and hemp tied on. It leaves the limbs free and holds more warmth than it looks like.
